cases.title: An IR books her own absence and the roster shows it
steps: Press Kavya Nair on the sign-in screen
Press 'Your account' in the top bar
Press 'Set your availability'
Choose 'On leave' in 'Absence reason · private'
Type '2026-08-31' in the Out from box
Type '2026-09-02' in the Back on box
Press 'Book absence'

cases.title: An absence longer than the roster allows is refused in the panel
steps: Press Kavya Nair on the sign-in screen
Press 'Your account' in the top bar
Press 'Set your availability'
Choose 'On leave' in 'Absence reason · private'
Type '2026-08-29' in the Out from box
Type '2026-10-29' in the Back on box
Press 'Book absence'
expected: The panel says 'Nothing changed — choose a start date from today and a later return date, at most 30 days ahead and 60 days long.'.
The panel still offers 'Book absence' and does not offer 'Cancel planned absence'.

cases.title: Marking an absent IR back in ends the cover of her leads (D44)
steps: Press Tasneem Qureshi on the sign-in screen
Press 'Your account' in the top bar
Press 'Team availability'
Press 'Change availability for Ananya Iyer'
Press 'Mark back in'
Press 'Your account' in the top bar
Press 'Sign out'
Press Nikhil Rao on the sign-in screen
Type 'Rahul Sethi' in the find-an-investor box
expected: Rahul Sethi is not offered in the search results.
